name: Article 42 – § 2 – point b – 52
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (b) a negative amount, the loss shall be set off against the taxable income of the ultimate parent entity and shall be carried forward for a maximum of 5 years and set off against the next positive BEFIT tax base. The deduction shall be in proportion to the holding of the ultimate parent entity in its qualifying subsidiaries as referred to in Article 3(1) and in full for permanent establishments. The reduction of the tax base of the resident taxpayer shall not result in a negative amount.
